description: Index of Industrial Production, manufacturing and its 23 NIC 2-digit divisions, 2022-23 base: latest month y/y as published by MoSPI, and the calendar year to date (January to the latest month) y/y, calculated by Asia Decoded as the ratio of summed indices (ytd_calculated = y). Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/iip/in_iip_divisions.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each monthly IIP release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
